rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: The HubSpot MCP server enables AI agents like Cursor and Claude Desktop to securely access and interact with HubSpot CRM data. Currently in beta, this Node.js-based implementation serves as a bridge between MCP-compatible clients and your HubSpot account, allowing agents to retrieve contact information, company records, deal data, and even perform actions like creating records or adding tasks. Developers can control data access through HubSpot Private App scopes, making it valuable for streamlining development workflows, gaining insights from CRM data, managing records, and automating routine HubSpot tasks without leaving their preferred AI environment.
